newsitem.title: UK: No special factors behind Standard's rise.
newsitem.headline: No special factors behind Standard's rise.

text.p: Banking group Standard Chartered Plc saw its shares gain 17 1/2 pence to 1017 1/2 on Monday in a broadly sluggish market, but analysts said there were no special factors behind the rise.

The volumes traded were small at 25,6312. One analyst said he had not heard of any factor driving the price, but added, "There has been a recent rise in Standard's share price and players are keen not to go short of stock," with further gains seen ahead.
The rest of the sector was more in line with the market, with HSBC Holdings Plc down four pence at 1793 and Barclays Plc down 11 1/2 pence at 1270.
